task: Browse the latest negative reviews from players with over 100 hours of playtime for the game that won the 2023 VR Game of the Year Award.
final_result_response:
The 2023 VR Game of the Year winner is Labyrinthine (confirmed by Steam Awards 2023 Winner banner on https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302240/Labyrinthine/).

Latest Negative reviews filtered by Playtime: Over 100 hours, sorted by Recent:

1. Gray - Not Recommended - 455.9 hrs on record (424.3 hrs at review time) - Posted Aug 14, 2025 - Lost all cosmetics 3 times (Easter, Summer hot dog hat, Halloween) and level reset from 400+ to 284, only his account affected while friends kept items.

2. Panda Rojo - Not Recommended - 441.5 hrs on record (440.1 hrs at review time) - Posted Aug 5, 2025 - Says in Spanish/English: game is very good but lack of new content is slowly killing it, no new content since release.

3. xlazyfox - Not Recommended - 252.6 hrs on record (246.8 hrs at review time) - Posted July 23, 2025 - Enjoyed story mode but post-story grind is a slog; ~250 hours and still not half cosmetics; complains about duplicate rolls (visor, granny glasses), suggests guaranteed super-rare stamp or buyable stamps and duplicate protection.

Further 100h+ negatives in same Recent order include Gramdaddy69 (130.4 hrs), Onion (399.9 hrs, 389 hrs at review), Rohan (286 hrs, 211.5 hrs at review), Maxwell Zentolight (143.6 hrs), Akkallia (255.3 hrs), Carnage (246.1 hrs), Annamatopoeia (405.8 hrs), Lil Bear (332.3 hrs), Iks (329.4 hrs).
